narr: An upper level trough brought a cold front into a warm, moist airmass and generated thunderstorms across South Central Texas. Some of these storms produced heavy rain that led to flash flooding.
ev: Thunderstorms produced nearly four inches of rain in under two hours that led to flash flooding. ATXFloods reported two low water crossings were flooded in southwestern Austin.
lsr: PAIR OF LOW WATER CROSSINGS CLOSED IN SW AUSTIN WHERE CLOSE TO 4 INCHES OF RAIN FELL IN UNDER 2 HOURS. PER ATXFLOODS.
